_doc: E357 S1.5: Nine Dragon's neon night market. EVERY family renders with MOSS-SoundEffect v2 and Stable Audio 3 Medium, 3 seeds each; CLAP selects the better engine. Four distinct footstep families per surface give four takes before each engine's seed variations. Dot IDs are the shard cue names; bed/hum prefixes are stripped only in manifest sections. All sounds go into nine-dragon-stack, never the global best set.

bed.nd.market.desc: a rainy night market crowd with distant hawkers and sizzling woks
bed.nd.market.prompt: Continuous ambience of a busy neon night market in a dense Chinese hillside city: a warm layered crowd murmur, distant hawkers calling in a Cantonese-like cadence with no intelligible words, woks sizzling at food stalls, steady rain pattering on tiled roofs and dripping into the street. A believable open courtyard recording, people at a distance, no foreground dialogue, no music, no melody, even texture suitable for looping.

bed.nd.well.desc: wind and chimes in a deep stone shaft with distant crowd murmur and light rain
bed.nd.well.prompt: Continuous ambience inside a deep open stone shaft below a night market: a soft hollow wind passing through galleries, delicate metal wind chimes ringing irregularly high above, a far-off muffled crowd murmur from the rim, light rain and slow drips echoing down the stone walls. Spacious, calm, deep and natural, no intelligible speech, no music, even texture suitable for looping.

hum.lantern.desc: the close steady electrical hum of neon tubes beside paper lanterns
hum.lantern.prompt: Close recording beside a cluster of neon tubes and illuminated paper lanterns: a soft steady low electrical transformer hum, faint high fluorescent buzz and tiny irregular glass vibration. Quiet warm urban night detail, constant with no start or stop, suitable for a seamless positional loop. No voices, no rain, no wind, no music.

step.stone.1.desc: one boot footstep on wet granite
step.stone.1.prompt: One boot landing heel first on a wet granite paving slab: a short hard stone tap with a tiny damp splash. Close, dry recording, exactly one footstep, no walking sequence, no music.

step.stone.2.desc: one damp shoe step on granite paving
step.stone.2.prompt: One firm shoe sole stepping onto rain-wet granite paving: a crisp flat stone knock and a soft wet sole slap. Close, exactly one footstep, no background crowd, no music.

step.stone.3.desc: one quick boot step across wet granite
step.stone.3.prompt: One quick boot toe landing on smooth wet granite: a light sharp stone tick with a tiny water flick. Close, exactly one footstep, no walking sequence, no music.

step.stone.4.desc: one heavy shoe step on a wet granite stair
step.stone.4.prompt: One weighted boot landing on a rain-wet granite stair tread: a low compact stone thock and brief watery sole squish. Close, exactly one footstep, no echo tail, no music.

step.wood.1.desc: one boot footstep on wet wooden planks
step.wood.1.prompt: One boot stepping on damp wooden gallery planks: a hollow wooden knock, tiny board creak and soft wet sole slap. Close, exactly one footstep, no music.

step.wood.2.desc: one shoe step on a rain-soaked timber board
step.wood.2.prompt: One shoe heel landing on a rain-soaked timber walkway board: a short resonant wooden clop and faint water flick. Close, exactly one footstep, no walking sequence, no music.

step.wood.3.desc: one light boot step on damp wooden decking
step.wood.3.prompt: One light boot toe step on damp wooden decking: a crisp little hollow wood tap and short creak. Close, exactly one footstep, no background ambience, no music.

step.wood.4.desc: one weighted shoe step on wet wooden stairs
step.wood.4.prompt: One weighted shoe sole landing on a wet wooden stair tread: a low hollow timber thud with a brief squeak and damp sole sound. Close, exactly one footstep, no music.

step.metal.1.desc: one boot footstep on steel grating
step.metal.1.prompt: One boot landing on a wet steel grating walkway: a sharp metallic clank and tiny resonant grille rattle. Close, exactly one footstep, no music.

step.metal.2.desc: one shoe heel striking a steel grate
step.metal.2.prompt: One shoe heel striking a damp steel grate: a bright short metal tick and a low lattice ring. Close, exactly one footstep, no walking sequence, no music.

step.metal.3.desc: one quick boot step on a metal catwalk
step.metal.3.prompt: One quick boot toe landing on a rain-wet steel catwalk grid: a crisp thin metallic tap and brief grille vibration. Close, exactly one footstep, no music.

step.metal.4.desc: one heavy boot step on steel stair grating
step.metal.4.prompt: One heavy boot landing on a steel grating stair tread: a compact low metal clang, small lattice rattle and damp sole slap. Close, exactly one footstep, no music.

jian.swing.desc: a light steel sword cutting through air
jian.swing.prompt: A light double-edged steel jian making one fast lateral cut through air: a clean narrow swish with a faint blade whistle. Close, one swing only, no impact, no voice, no music.

jian.swing.heavy.desc: a heavy overhead sword swing through air
jian.swing.heavy.prompt: A steel jian driven in one powerful overhead cut: a deeper rising rush of air followed by a sharp blade whoosh and short whistle. Close, one heavy swing only, no impact, no voices, no music.

jian.hit.stone.desc: a steel sword blade striking stone
jian.hit.stone.prompt: A steel jian blade striking a granite edge once: a sharp hard metallic crack with a gritty stone chip and a brief blade ring. Close, one impact only, no music.

jian.hit.wood.desc: a steel sword blade striking wood
jian.hit.wood.prompt: A sharp steel jian chopping into a wooden beam once: a solid woody thunk, crisp fibres cracking and a small blade vibration. Close, one impact only, no metal-on-metal clang, no music.

jian.clang.desc: two steel sword blades meeting with a ringing clang
jian.clang.prompt: Two thin steel jian blades meeting in one hard parry: a bright ringing metal clang with a short shimmering steel resonance. Close, exactly one clash, no voices, no music.

feizhua.fire.desc: a brass grapple claw firing on a cord
feizhua.fire.prompt: A spring-loaded brass grappling claw fired from a wrist gauntlet on a braided cord: a compact mechanical snap, brass clack and quick cord hiss rushing outward. Close, one launch only, no gunshot, no music.

feizhua.bite.desc: a brass grapple claw biting onto an anchor
feizhua.bite.prompt: A brass three-pronged grapple claw catching an iron anchor ring once: a sharp brass-and-iron clink, claws snapping shut with a firm mechanical bite. Close, one catch only, no music.

feizhua.reel.desc: a grapple cord reeling into a gauntlet
feizhua.reel.prompt: A braided grapple cord quickly reeled into a wrist gauntlet: a short accelerating mechanical spool whirr, soft cord rasp and tiny brass ratchet ticks, ending cleanly. Close, one reel action, no music.

feizhua.dock.desc: a brass claw docking into a wrist gauntlet
feizhua.dock.prompt: A retracting brass grapple claw docking into its wrist gauntlet once: a compact solid brass clack, spring latch snapping into place and tiny final mechanism click. Close, one docking action only, no music.

feizhua.zip.desc: a fast rushing zip along a taut grapple cord
feizhua.zip.prompt: One rapid traversal along a taut grapple cord: a rising rush of air with a tight humming cord and a brief sliding pulley whizz, ending with a clean stop. Athletic and close, no voice, no music.

chime.gust.desc: a gust ringing a string of metal wind chimes
chime.gust.prompt: One gentle gust passing through a hanging string of small bronze and steel wind chimes in a deep stone courtyard: an irregular cluster of delicate bright chinks and mellow ringing tones, fading naturally. Close, one gust only, no melody, no voices, no music.
